name: semaphore
description: Concurrency limiter (Semaphore) to throttle parallel async tasks execution.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when throttling resource-heavy tasks like parallel web requests, massive filesystem writes, or database queries to avoid hitting rate limits or memory exhaustion. Import using: import { Semaphore } from './async/semaphore.js';

parameters.name: maxConcurrency
parameters.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active async operations.
